name: Novalis website
description: Static marketing site for Novalis d.o.o. (Novalja, Pag): landing page, O nama and six store pages. Plain HTML/CSS/JS, no build step.

jira.mcpTools: mcp__plugin_design_atlassian__* (Atlassian MCP from the synced 'design' plugin); read tools are listed in .claude/agents/jira-requirements-analyst.md

acceptanceCriteria.location: Ticket description, under a heading 'Acceptance criteria' (also accepted: 'AC', 'Kriteriji prihvaćanja') as a bullet or numbered list; the project has no dedicated AC field.

jira.myOpenTicketsJql: project = WEB AND assignee = currentUser() AND statusCategory != Done AND status != "On hold" ORDER BY priority DESC, created ASC
jira.writePolicy: read-only; every Jira write (comment, transition, edit, worklog, link) needs the Product Owner's explicit approval for that operation

git.commitPolicy: never commit automatically; commit only when the Product Owner asks

stack.dependencies: none at runtime (fonts self-hosted in assets/fonts; MapLibre vendored in js/vendor; map tiles from OpenFreeMap)

structure.data: data/units.js (units, categories, hours, occasions, store-page content)

commands.previewNote: Serve the workspace root; pages live at /, /o-nama/, /<store-slug>/. The site must also work from file:// (site.js appends index.html on click).
commands.smokeOptions: --root <workspace> (default: repo root), --pages <slugs>, --widths <px,...>, --no-axe, --shots <dir>, --json <file>, --baseline <json from an earlier --json run: its failures are KNOWN, only new ones fail>. Full run ~60 s (8 pages x 3 widths with axe).
commands.knownIssues: Baseline 2026-10-10: index.html links to #posao, #privatnost, #cjenici have no target (jobs/privacy/price-list pages not built yet; WEB-20, WEB-23).

browser.automation: playwright-skill (~/.claude/skills/playwright-skill, run scripts with its run.js or require its node_modules/playwright)
browser.channelNote: macOS 13: Playwright's bundled Chromium is unsupported; always launch system Google Chrome (channel 'chrome', PW_CHANNEL=chrome is set in user settings). Do not run `playwright install`.

design.rules: CLAUDE.md (tab shape R R R 0, no soft shadows, Outfit/Figtree stand-ins, logo only from vector paths/files, low-poly footer art is the client's own work)
design.newDesignsGoThrough: a claude.ai Design artifact for Product Owner approval before build (design first, build after approval)

content.unconfirmed: Opening hours are placeholders except Pod Zvon; Market phone number and some claims are awaiting Novalis (see memory/notes). Never present them as confirmed.
content.style: CLAUDE.md copy style: hyphens not em/en dashes, ranges with spaced hyphen (07:00 - 19:00), Croatian dates (15. 5.), unit names in translate="no", new-tab links announce ' (nova kartica)'.

seo.perPageHead: title, description, canonical, Open Graph per page; keep in sync with data/units.js
seo.structuredData: JSON-LD built from data/units.js; only hours with hoursConfirmed: true are published

quality.accessibility: WCAG 2.2 AA (automated axe + manual keyboard/contrast spot checks; not a certification)
quality.contrast: text on brand colours must reach 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text and UI parts)
quality.browsers: Chrome (automated); Safari/iOS and Firefox are manual-only and must be listed as untested unless checked
quality.performance: no build step: check image weights/dimensions, render-blocking resources and layout shift on changed pages

conventions: Every page starts with a skip link to its <main>.
Store pages are identical shells: <body data-unit="…" data-root="../" data-home="../">; same sections in the same order; only the hero takes the store theme.
Link to store pages with NV.unitHref(u) (clean slug/ URLs).
Use css/ds.css variables; no new brand colours.
Content changes go through data/units.js, not hard-coded in page scripts.

orchestratorOnly: Cache busting: when any CSS or JS file changed, bump ?v=YYYYMMDD (or -2, -3 the same day) in all 8 HTML pages, once per integration, after all tickets in the batch are applied.

deploy.target: git push origin main -> GitHub Pages (ivana0207.github.io/novalis-web) and Vercel (novalis-web.vercel.app)
deploy.policy: Only on the Product Owner's explicit instruction in the current conversation. The guard hook asks before any push.

resources.note: Checkpoints, not hard limits. WARN: the orchestrator reassesses its strategy (duplication, repeated attempts, unneeded re-verification) and continues. APPROVAL: it pauses before further expensive work and asks the Product Owner. Per ticket; work shared by several tickets is split between them. Cost = measured tokens x list prices (pricing) - an estimate. estFiveHourWindowPct converts it with the subscription calibration below. null disables a limit.

subscription.plan: claude.ai subscription with 5-hour and 7-day usage windows (rate-limit events show overage disabled)
subscription.calibration: 2026-10-10: the 5-hour window moved 58% -> 95% while $14.75 (list-price estimate) was measured across the WEB-25 dry run and the concurrent setup session: about $0.40 per 1%. One sample, approximate - recalibrate from rate_limit_event lines of a headless run (claude -p --output-format stream-json) or from /usage.
subscription.reference: WEB-25 dry run (analysis + planning + one design spec, stopped before ingest): $7.26 ~ 18% of a 5-hour window

pricing.source: claude-api skill model table + shared/prompt-caching.md (Anthropic first-party list prices)
pricing.unit: USD per million tokens; cache writes are priced as 1.25x input (5-minute TTL) or 2x input (1-hour TTL)
pricing.note: Estimates at API list price. Subscription plans are not billed per token. Update when Anthropic prices change.
